Also worth folding in: the spec.validate min-strength pin at spec_tasks_test.exs (~:951 post-0x4.3) is untagged for verdict_line (whole-file stub still executes it; per-test attribution does not credit it), and Keyword.get's default :tier in both print_verdict clauses silently mislabels a future call site that forgets the key — consider Keyword.fetch! for :tier.

ADMISSION VERIFICATION (specled_-k6s, 2026-07-27)
Cold fresh-context verifier run against the epic base tree (feat/specled_-td7-self-identifying-descriptors @ e81f9f98).

VERDICT: still_applicable   EFFORT: small
Mandate confirmed still applicable as written; no narrowing needed.

== SCOPED REMAINING WORK ==
All of it. Six concrete edits:

1. lib/mix/tasks/spec.validate.ex — add `alias SpecLedEx.TaskArgs` (next to the existing aliases at :6-9). Delete `validate_args!/2` (:124-132) and replace the call at :49 with the spec.check.ex:71-78 shape:
     case TaskArgs.validate("spec.validate", rest, invalid) do
       :ok -> :ok
       {:error, message} ->
         print_verdict("fail", tier: "usage", error_findings: 0)
         Mix.raise(message)
     end
   End state: `mix spec.validate --bogusflag` last stdout line is exactly `spec.validate result=fail tier=usage error_findings=0`, and the raised message text stays `Invalid arguments for spec.validate: --bogusflag` (TaskArgs.validate/3 already produces that string, so the regex at spec_tasks_test.exs:192 keeps matching).

2. lib/mix/tasks/spec.validate.ex:228 — `tier = Keyword.get(opts, :tier, "validate")` becomes `tier = Keyword.fetch!(opts, :tier)`. Then the one remaining defaulted call site, :117 `print_verdict("fail", error_findings: summary["errors"])`, must become `print_verdict("fail", tier: "validate", error_findings: summary["errors"])`. The :169 min-strength site already passes `tier: "usage"`. Keep the `error_findings || 0` nil guard at :232 (summary["errors"] can be nil).

3. .spec/specs/mix_tasks.spec.md:283-284 — in requirement specled.tasks.verdict_line, change the last alternative from `spec.validate result=fail tier=validate error_findings=<N>` to `spec.validate result=fail tier=<usage|validate> error_findings=<N>`, so the grammar admits the wli min-strength verdict and the new arg-rejection verdict.

4. .spec/specs/mix_tasks.spec.md:317 — in scenario specled.tasks.verdict_line.stdout_contract, generalize the then-clause "A spec.check pre-flight rejection and a spec.validate min-strength pre-flight rejection use `tier=usage`; spec.check does not print a `validate status=` line on that path." so spec.validate's ARGUMENT-rejection path is also named (e.g. "spec.check and spec.validate pre-flight rejections — unknown arguments, invalid --min-strength, and spec.check's bad --base — use `tier=usage`; …"). Do not delete the clause (keeps append_only/scenario_regression, which counts scenarios per requirement, unaffected either way).

5. test/mix/tasks/spec_tasks_test.exs:191-199 — flip the assertion at :198 to `assert List.last(messages) == "spec.validate result=fail tier=usage error_findings=0"` and add `@tag spec: ["specled.tasks.verdict_line"]` immediately above the `test "spec.validate rejects invalid CLI options"` line. Leave :182 alone — that is a genuine strict-validation failure and correctly stays `tier=validate`.

6. test/mix/tasks/spec_tasks_test.exs:940 — insert `@tag spec: ["specled.tasks.verdict_line"]` above `test "spec.validate rejects invalid min strength values"` (:941).

Plus a CHANGELOG.md "Fixed" bullet under the unreleased/next heading, matching the style of the existing wli/0x4.2 bullets at CHANGELOG.md:141-149.

== EXPECTED TOUCHES ==
lib/mix/tasks/spec.validate.ex, .spec/specs/mix_tasks.spec.md, test/mix/tasks/spec_tasks_test.exs, CHANGELOG.md

== RISK NOTES ==
REALIZATION HASH: no drift expected. `.spec/realization_hashes.json` stores only the `api_boundary` class (172 entries; `Mix.Tasks.Spec.Validate` = cbb662e7…, `Mix.Tasks.Spec.Validate.run/1` = ec7cf841…). api_boundary hashes function HEADS only — see lib/specled_ex/realization/api_boundary.ex:6-13 ("stable under formatting changes, variable renames, and line-number shifts … including edits above it") and lib/specled_ex/realization/canonical.ex:175-187 (`hash_module_head_union` envelopes only public exports). The work adds no public function, changes no head/arity/default, so both bindings are untouched. The `implementation` tier (which WOULD hash full bodies) is not enabled: lib/specled_ex/realization/orchestrator.ex:72 `@default_tiers [:api_boundary, :expanded_behavior, :typespecs, :use]` and `.spec/config.yml` has no `realization:` key. Do NOT regenerate realization_hashes.json.

SPEC REQUIREMENT OVERLAP: this ticket owns `specled.tasks.verdict_line` (.spec/specs/mix_tasks.spec.md:271-289) and its scenario `…stdout_contract` (:307-320). I grepped all 21 sibling tickets for "spec.validate", "mix_tasks", "spec_tasks_test", "verdict_line", "TaskArgs" — zero hits. No file+region conflict in the set.

ORDERING: independent; no ticket must land first. Only shared file in the whole set is CHANGELOG.md (every ticket adds a bullet) — append-only, trivial merge, but tell implementers to add bullets rather than restructure the section.

GATE: the fix re-runs the `kind: tagged_tests / execute: true` verification entry covering `specled.tasks.verdict_line` + `specled.tasks.branch_findings_breakdown` (.spec/specs/mix_tasks.spec.md:373-377). Adding the two `@tag spec:` lines changes per-test attribution for that leg; tagged_tests legs in this repo are load-sensitive/flaky under concurrency, so a single failure there should be re-run serially before being treated as real.

BRANCH GUARD: spec text and code change together in the same PR, so `branch_guard_subject_cochange` is satisfied. No ADR needed — this is a grammar-widening reconciliation, not an architectural change (the enumeration at :274-276 already asserted the behavior).
